[Verse 1]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                       [ch]F[/ch]             [ch]C[/ch]
Hear the blessed Savior calling the oppressed,[/tab]
[tab][ch]G7[/ch]                                  [ch]C[/ch]
“Oh, ye heavy-laden, come to Me and rest;[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                      [ch]F[/ch]                [ch]C[/ch]
Come, no longer tarry, I your load will bear,[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]           [ch]G7[/ch] [ch]F[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]        [ch]G7[/ch]    [ch]C[/ch]
Bring Me every burden, bring Me every care.”[/tab]

[Chorus]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]             [ch]G7[/ch]              [ch]C[/ch]
Come unto Me, I will give you rest;[/tab]
[tab][ch]F[/ch]              [ch]C[/ch]       [ch]D[/ch]              [ch]G[/ch]
Take My yoke upon you, hear Me and be blest;[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                    [ch]F[/ch]                 [ch]C[/ch]
I am meek and lowly, come and trust My might;[/tab]
[tab][ch]C[/ch]                [ch]F[/ch]     [ch]C[/ch]      [ch]G7[/ch]       [ch]C[/ch]
Come, My yoke is easy, and My burden’s light.[/tab]
